description: This file defines utility functions and classes for security token management, Thunder plugin communication, and plugin activation within a C++ project, including security token retrieval via curl, and plugin state management.

classes.name: SecurityToken
classes.description: Provides static methods to retrieve and manage security tokens, including checking security configuration via curl.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: A dispatchable job class that executes a provided function, with different inheritance depending on compile-time flags.

methods.name: getSecurityToken
methods.description: Retrieves a security token, caching it for subsequent calls, and checks if Thunder security is configured.

methods.name: writeCurlResponse
methods.description: Callback to write curl response data into a string stream.

methods.name: isThunderSecurityConfigured
methods.description: Checks if Thunder security subsystem is configured by querying a local HTTP endpoint.
